programme.title: We Are Sexual Beings: Curious Australia
programme.desc: This observational documentary explores what being young, with a disability and sexual in modern Australia is all about. Over the course of 24-hours, three young Australians with disabilities will pull back the covers on their intimate lives. Oli, an aspiring tennis champ; Maya, an earnest sweetheart; and Christina, a wild-child motorhead - are three remarkably different human beings, who all happen to share two things in common: life-altering spinal injuries and healthy sexual appetites.

programme.title: Myths: Greatest Mysteries Of Humanity
programme.desc: Tutankhamun's burial chamber is one of the largest archaeological discoveries to date. Some even believe that the discovery of the tomb prompted a series of mysterious deaths. In the ten-year period after Howard Carter's research team discovered Tutankhamun's tomb in 1922, 17 people associated with the expedition died. Many believe there is only one explanation for this: the curse of the Pharaoh, placed upon all those who dare to disturb the resting place of the great king.

programme.title: Insight

Many believe there is only one explanation for this: the curse of the Pharaoh, placed upon all those who dare to disturb the resting place of the great king.

With this, he opened his restaurant, Moi Moi. Meeting his brother Leroy at their favourite local market, they collect produce to cook his Aunty 5's cakes with Pork and Tiger Prawn and a Braised Pork Belly with 63 degree egg. Then, venturing out of the city traditional Hakka cuisine, Luke meets locals who share their knowledge for Yellow Wine Chicken and Hakka Stuffed Tofu amongst the picturesque Hong Kong countryside.

She teaches him to cook a White Bean Congee with Steamed Pork neck with salted fish, fish egg and a salted duck egg out of her stilt house. programme.desc: This observational documentary explores what being young, with a disability and sexual in modern Australia is all about. Over the course of 24-hours, three young Australians with disabilities will pull back the covers on their intimate lives. Oli, an aspiring tennis champ; Maya, an earnest sweetheart; and Christina, a wild-child motorhead - are three remarkably different human beings, who all happen to share two things in common: life-altering spinal injuries and healthy sexual appetites.

programme.title: Myths: Greatest Mysteries Of Humanity
programme.desc: Tutankhamun's burial chamber is one of the largest archaeological discoveries to date. Some even believe that the discovery of the tomb prompted a series of mysterious deaths. In the ten-year period after Howard Carter's research team discovered Tutankhamun's tomb in 1922, 17 people associated with the expedition died. Many believe there is only one explanation for this: the curse of the Pharaoh, placed upon all those who dare to disturb the resting place of the great king.

Over the course of 24-hours, three young Australians with disabilities will pull back the covers on their intimate lives. Oli, an aspiring tennis champ; Maya, an earnest sweetheart; and Christina, a wild-child motorhead - are three remarkably different human beings, who all happen to share two things in common: life-altering spinal injuries and healthy sexual appetites.

programme.title: Myths: Greatest Mysteries Of Humanity
programme.desc: Tutankhamun's burial chamber is one of the largest archaeological discoveries to date. Some even believe that the discovery of the tomb prompted a series of mysterious deaths. In the ten-year period after Howard Carter's research team discovered Tutankhamun's tomb in 1922, 17 people associated with the expedition died. Many believe there is only one explanation for this: the curse of the Pharaoh, placed upon all those who dare to disturb the resting place of the great king.

programme.desc: Exploring the traditional style of Cantonese specialties, Luke hikes to a Dim Sum house where he helps prepare some of their most popular dim sum, a Quail Egg Siu Mai, and Steamed Rice rolls with dried shrimp. Further out of the city, Luke explores Lantau Island, where he meets local Aunty Peng. She teaches him to cook a White Bean Congee with Steamed Pork neck with salted fish, fish egg and a salted duck egg out of her stilt house. Travelling down the coast to Yin Yang Coastal, he meets private kitchen dining chef, Margaret Xu, who shares her secrets to her traditional 'Yellow Earth Chicken' roasted out of her terracotta urn in her private kitchen.

programme.title: We Are Sexual Beings: Curious Australia
programme.desc: This observational documentary explores what being young, with a disability and sexual in modern Australia is all about. Over the course of 24-hours, three young Australians with disabilities will pull back the covers on their intimate lives. Oli, an aspiring tennis champ; Maya, an earnest sweetheart; and Christina, a wild-child motorhead - are three remarkably different human beings, who all happen to share two things in common: life-altering spinal injuries and healthy sexual appetites.

programme.title: Myths: Greatest Mysteries Of Humanity
programme.desc: Tutankhamun's burial chamber is one of the largest archaeological discoveries to date. Some even believe that the discovery of the tomb prompted a series of mysterious deaths. In the ten-year period after Howard Carter's research team discovered Tutankhamun's tomb in 1922, 17 people associated with the expedition died. Many believe there is only one explanation for this: the curse of the Pharaoh, placed upon all those who dare to disturb the resting place of the great king.

programme.desc: A thousand years have passed since the violent collapse of industrial civilisation. Small pockets of humanity survive on the fringes of a vast polluted forest, the Toxic Jungle, inhabited by giant mutated insects, of which the Ohmu, are the greatest threat. The plant life and the spores from the jungle are poisonous to humans. Anyone who ventures into the jungle must wear breathing masks to protect their lungs. The Valley of the Wind is a small community of humans protected by sea breezes from the toxic spores. Their young princess, Nausicaä, tries to understand, rather than destroy the Toxic Jungle. programme.sub-title: Roquefort, Revisiting King Of The Blues
programme.desc: Roquefort is the most significant of all blue cheeses, it's one of the world's oldest cheeses and one of the few blue cheeses still made from raw milk. To find out what's changed since his last visit to the famous village of Roquefort-sur-Soulzon, Will and Ellie catch up with the makers of Papillon Roquefort, one of the most respected and well-known export brands from the region. Another of the finest boutique Roquefort producers is Carles and Will takes Ellie into the companies iconic limestone caves to speak to Delphine Carles and sample some of her delectable blue cheeses.

Luke breaks down the barriers behind the logistics of opening a restaurant; from the kitchen to service, and finally, he welcomes us to the opening of Vietnam House. Luke, together with his team of hand-picked chefs, cook a couple of featured dishes of the new menu.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 10

Luke visits the best spot for milk tea, a Hong Kong style breakfast Congee and Rice Noodle and he visits one of the only traditional Yum Cha style teahouses in Central Hong Kong. After exploring the traditional side of Hong Kong, Luke visits his friend who adds a modern twist to a Chinese desert using liquid nitrogen.

Oli, an aspiring tennis champ; Maya, an earnest sweetheart; and Christina, a wild-child motorhead - are three remarkably different human beings, who all happen to share two things in common: life-altering spinal injuries and healthy sexual appetites.

programme.title: Myths: Greatest Mysteries Of Humanity

Many believe there is only one explanation for this: the curse of the Pharaoh, placed upon all those who dare to disturb the resting place of the great king.

programme.desc: Exploring the traditional style of Cantonese specialties, Luke hikes to a Dim Sum house where he helps prepare some of their most popular dim sum, a Quail Egg Siu Mai, and Steamed Rice rolls with dried shrimp. Further out of the city, Luke explores Lantau Island, where he meets local Aunty Peng. She teaches him to cook a White Bean Congee with Steamed Pork neck with salted fish, fish egg and a salted duck egg out of her stilt house. Travelling down the coast to Yin Yang Coastal, he meets private kitchen dining chef, Margaret Xu, who shares her secrets to her traditional 'Yellow Earth Chicken' roasted out of her terracotta urn in her private kitchen.

Many believe there is only one explanation for this: the curse of the Pharaoh, placed upon all those who dare to disturb the resting place of the great king.
